This definition does not extend to content that merely criticizes or questions the legitimacy of an exchange.

It applies to profiles that are clearly intended to mislead others into believing they are the genuine entity. The label does not cover opinions or speculative analysis that is clearly labeled as such, nor does it apply to content that is merely outdated without intent to mislead. Key indicators include claims contradicted by official sources, fabricated quotes or data, and promotion of known falsehoods. This definition does not extend to content that is simply critical or skeptical of a project or trend.

It applies to accounts that initiate private conversations to share links, offers, or requests that are deceptive or harmful. The label does not cover legitimate business inquiries or messages from known contacts, nor does it apply to public posts or comments.
